Description: A projection of linked circles from four-dimensional S3 into three-dimensional space, turning the Hopf fibration into a rotating family of interlocked clone fibers.
KScript: var phase_a := t*v0+u*v2+x*v1*0.01; var phase_b := t*v3+u*v2*1.37+y*v1*0.01; var family := t*v6+u*v7; var radius_a := v4+v5*cos(family); var radius_b := v4-v5*cos(family); var a1 := radius_a*cos(phase_a); var a2 := radius_a*sin(phase_a); var b1 := radius_b*cos(phase_b); var b2 := radius_b*sin(phase_b); var hx := 2.0*(a1*b1+a2*b2)*v8; var hy := 2.0*(a2*b1-a1*b2)*v8; var hz := (a1*a1+a2*a2-b1*b1-b2*b2)*v8; x += hx; y += hy; z += hz; rz += sin(phase_a-phase_b)*v9;

Variables.Tooltip: Angular speed of the first S3 circle
